targets.name: e_comp_sub
targets.statement: theorem e_comp_sub {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) : HTE.comp bd C S ⊆ S
targets.proof:
theorem e_comp_sub {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) : HTE.comp bd C S ⊆ S := by
  simp [HTE.comp]

targets.name: e_mem_comp
targets.statement: theorem e_mem_comp {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) (p : P) : p ∈ HTE.comp bd C S ↔ p ∈ S ∧ HTE.Attached bd S C p
targets.proof:
theorem e_mem_comp {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) (p : P) : p ∈ HTE.comp bd C S ↔ p ∈ S ∧ HTE.Attached bd S C p := by
  simp [HTE.comp]

targets.name: e_touch
targets.statement: theorem e_touch {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) {p : P} {l : L} (hp : p ∈ S) (hlC : l ∈ C) (hl : l ∈ bd p) : HTE.Attached bd S C p
targets.proof:
theorem e_touch {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) {p : P} {l : L} (hp : p ∈ S) (hlC : l ∈ C) (hl : l ∈ bd p) : HTE.Attached bd S C p := by
  simp [HTE.Attached]
  grind

targets.name: e_wilson_empty
targets.statement: theorem e_wilson_empty {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (U : L → Bool) : HTE.wilson (∅ : Finset L) U = 1
targets.proof:
theorem e_wilson_empty {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (U : L → Bool) : HTE.wilson (∅ : Finset L) U = 1 := by
  rfl

targets.name: e_spin_sq
targets.proof:
theorem e_spin_sq (b : Bool) : spin b ^ 2 = 1 := by
  simp [spin]

targets.statement: theorem e_comp_empty_C {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) : HTE.comp bd ∅ S = ∅
targets.proof:
theorem e_comp_empty_C {L P : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] (bd : P → Finset L) (C : Finset L) (S : Finset P) : HTE.comp bd ∅ S = ∅ := by
  unfold HTE.comp
  simp [HTE.Attached]
